title: Death approaches
next_chapter_hook: "At the very moment when the Heavenly Eye was about to complete its final judgment, an intervention from the Heavenly Secrets Pavilion forcibly tore apart the script of fate—that voice cold and ancient: 'Holder of the Tianji Record, your time to fall has not yet come.'"

text.content: "The nights at Tianqing Sect always came especially long. Chen Ji stood before the window of the dilapidated Servants' Quarters, watching his fingertips becoming transparent at a visible speed—that was the precursor of the seven-hundredth chapter's death prophecy in the Tianji Record. His body was being eroded bit by bit by some invisible force, like being scorched by intangible flames."

"'As expected, it's here.' Chen Ji said softly, his voice so calm it was as if he weren't facing death. He raised his hand, watching moonlight pierce through his palm, casting a faint spot of light on the ground. When he first saw this prophecy three years ago, he took it as a joke; when he saw it a second time a year ago, he began to lay plans; and now, the prophecy arrived as scheduled, yet he still hadn't found a way to break the situation."

dialogue.content: "Tianji Record, I remember it wrote—'Fate can be defied, cause and effect can be severed, only the word 'emotion' is hardest to solve.' Since that's the case, then use emotion to break your game."

text.content: "He stumbled out of the Servants' Quarters, each step like stepping on knife points. The intense pain in his chest reminded him that the prophecy was accelerating its fulfillment. According to the Tianji Record's display, he would die from 'Heart Pulse Severance' within three hours—the most humiliating way to die, where even his bones would turn to ash after death, as if he had never existed."

"Yet Chen Ji's eyes were exceptionally clear. He wasn't waiting for death; he was calculating. With every breath, countless possibilities were rapidly operating in his mind. The prophecy said 'Heart Pulse Severance'—what if his heart pulse was no longer the original one? The prophecy said 'turn to ash'—what if someone was willing to bear this karma for him?"

choice.prompt: "Chen Ji must make a choice before the prophecy is fulfilled—what method will he use to break this certain-death situation?"

choices.text: "Break the game with wisdom, reverse deduction"
choices.description: "Exploit the loophole in the Tianji Record—the prophecy is a 'seen future,' not the 'only future.' As long as the observer's identity changes, the prophecy will deviate."
choices.risk_hint: "The Heavenly Eye may detect and accelerate the prophecy"

text.content: "Chen Ji closed his eyes, pouring all his spirit into the Tianji Record Fragment. He began to actively 'observe' the instant of his own death—not passively waiting, but actively observing. When he entered that prophecy from a first-person perspective, something strange happened: the image began to distort."

choices.text: "Break the game with emotion, transfer the karma"
choices.description: "Let Tianqing (the hidden piece he had secretly cultivated) voluntarily accept his 'death karma,' using the power of bonds to tangle the threads of fate. Sacrifice one person, in exchange for survival."
choices.visible_cost: "Tianqing will suffer three years of illness torment"

text.content: "Chen Ji bit through his tongue, using his refined blood as a guide, activating the ancient seal buried within Tianqing. A strand of crimson light shot from his chest, piercing through the night sky, reaching several miles away. Tianqing's body stiffened suddenly, then curled up in agony—that was the 'Death Substitution Talisman' Chen Ji had prepared three years ago."

choices.text: "Break the game with life, face it head-on"
choices.description: "Abandon all calculations, use the most primitive method—burn all one's Heavenly Fate points, forcibly tear an opening in the river of fate."
choices.visible_reward: "May directly break the prophecy and trigger hidden plot"
choices.risk_hint: "If failed, will die completely and cannot be resurrected"

text.content: "Chen Ji laughed wildly. He spread his arms wide, letting that death force spread within his body. At the same time, he began to frantically burn the Heavenly Fate points he had painstakingly accumulated. Every point of Heavenly Fate burned against the erosion of fate, like lighting a torch in the darkness."

"The moment Chen Ji chose to break the game with wisdom, he felt a cold consciousness descend from the Void. That was the Heavenly Eye—that transcendent existence was 'gazing' at him through some means. Chen Ji's heart slammed, but he forced himself to remain calm."

dialogue.content: "Chen Ji, you dare to peer into Heavenly Secrets? Do you think this paltry illusion can deceive me?"

text.content: "That voice was like an ancient temple bell, echoing in Chen Ji's mind. He felt his reverse observation being eroded by an invisible force, the image becoming increasingly unstable. Yet Chen Ji showed no panic—he was waiting for precisely this moment."

dialogue.content: "Senior Heavenly Eye, you've finally decided to appear. The junior has waited for this day for a very long time. You're right, reverse observation indeed cannot break the prophecy—but it can draw you out, and that's enough."

text.content: "Chen Ji suddenly opened his eyes, his pupils reflecting a blurry pattern—that was the information fragments about the Heavenly Eye he had gathered through various channels over three years. He didn't know what this thing truly was, but he knew it wasn't invincible."

choice.prompt: "Chen Ji successfully drew out the Heavenly Eye's consciousness projection. Now he must make his next decision—how to utilize this rare opportunity?"

choices.description: "Use this brief 'dialogue' opportunity to probe the Heavenly Eye's true purpose and weaknesses. Chen Ji's sharp tongue and rhetoric are his greatest weapons."
choices.visible_reward: "Gain important intelligence about the Heavenly Eye"

text.content: "A mocking smile curled at the corner of Chen Ji's mouth. His voice, though weak, was crystal clear: 'Does Senior have to determine others' fates this way every time? Using a vague prophecy to grant life, to grant death—don't you find it boring?'"

choices.description: "Stop pretending, directly declare one's rebellious will to the Heavenly Eye. In the most domineering way, tell it: you cannot kill me."
choices.visible_cost: "May be directly erased by the Heavenly Eye"
choices.visible_reward: "Establish an undying reputation before all under heaven"
choices.risk_hint: "Current strength is completely unable to oppose the Heavenly Eye"

text.content: "Chen Ji laughed long and skyward, his voice carrying a desperate heroism of breaking cauldrons and sinking boats: 'I, Chen Ji, am merely atrash Outer Disciple servant, but I refuse to believe in this so-called fate! Today you kill me, and tomorrow I will surely trample your so-called heaven flat!'"

choices.description: "Don't provoke, don't probe, just constantly drain the Heavenly Eye's attention. Buy time for the incoming intervention from the Heavenly Secrets Pavilion."
choices.visible_reward: "Ensure the Heavenly Secrets Pavilion's intervention succeeds"
choices.risk_hint: "May exhaust Heavenly Fate points before the Heavenly Secrets Pavilion arrives"

text.content: "Chen Ji began speaking nonsense without direction, from the history of Tianqing Sect to the grievances between the Three Great Sects, from legends of the Ancient Forbidden Land to reasons for the Demonic Path invasion. His voice was weak but firm, like running a desperate marathon."

"However, at this moment, Chen Ji felt the death symptoms within his body intensify suddenly. That cold erosive force suddenly turned violent, as if the Heavenly Eye had sensed his intention. An intense pain exploded from his heart, Chen Ji knelt on one knee, and a mouthful of blood gushed out."

"'No more playing with you.' Chen Ji wiped the blood from the corner of his mouth, a flash of madness crossing his eyes. He knew his time was running out—perhaps only one last chance remained. The intense pain in his chest grew more severe; he could feel his heart pulse breaking bit by bit."

"At this critical moment, Chen Ji remembered an ancient passage on the Tianji Record Fragment: 'Heavenly Secrets cannot be revealed, fate's numbers can still be defied. Only those with steadfast conviction can find a thread of life in a certain-death situation.' He had always thought it was merely empty encouragement, but now, he seemed to understand something."

choice.prompt: "The countdown to death has begun. Chen Ji must make his final choice—how to use this final conviction to break destiny?"

choices.description: "Chen Nian—that sister taken away by the Holy Sect, is his greatest weakness and also his greatest motivation to survive. Use this conviction to activate the hidden function of the Tianji Record."
choices.risk_hint: "May expose sister's existence to the Heavenly Eye"

text.content: "Chen Ji closed his eyes, desperately calling a name in his heart—Chen Nian. That blurry, never-clear figure became exceptionally distinct at this moment. A strange power erupted from his Tianji Record Fragment—that was the power of 'bond.'"

choices.description: "Transform all anger and hatred into power, swear to make the Heavenly Eye pay the price. This pure hatred may activate some forbidden function of the Tianji Record."
choices.visible_reward: "Unlock title 'Heaven's Nemesis,' gain resistance against the Heavenly Eye"
choices.risk_hint: "May completely fall to the opposite side of Heaven's Way"

text.content: "Chen Ji abruptly raised his head, his eyes filled with murderous madness. His voice became low and terrifying: 'Who do you think you are? Lofty Heaven? Judge deciding life and death? One day, I will personally drag you down from your divine throne!'"

choices.description: "Place personal life and death aside, heart only wanting to protect those innocent people. This great righteousness may move some transcendent existence to intervene."
choices.risk_hint: "Heavenly Eye may therefore lock onto him as the greatest threat"

text.content: "Chen Ji thought of those who had been saved because of him, of the innocent disciples in Tianqing Sect, of the calamity about to befall all under heaven. A warm power rose from the depths of his heart—that was the power of 'protection.'"

"Chen Ji chose the first path—conviction toward his sister. When that name rang in his heart, the entire Tianji Record Fragment quivered. A warm golden light rose from the Fragment, slowly enveloping Chen Ji's collapsing body. The speed of death's erosion suddenly slowed."

"'Found it!' Chen Ji abruptly opened his eyes, his eyes filled with joy. Within that golden light, he saw a blurry scene—Chen Nian imprisoned in a mysterious underground chamber, surrounded by complex formations. She was still alive, and right near Tianqing Sect!"

"However, the Heavenly Eye clearly sensed all of this too. That cold consciousness suddenly intensified, the golden light began to tremble violently. Chen Ji felt his head being crushed by something, the pain unbearable. 'Give up, Chen Ji. You cannot protect anyone.' The Heavenly Eye's voice rang out again."

dialogue.content: "Cannot protect? I never thought about protecting anyone. I just... want one person to live a good life. This tiny wish, will you also obstruct?"

text.content: "Chen Ji's voice trembled, but his will was unprecedentedly firm. At this moment, a huge crack suddenly appeared in the sky, an ancient and majestic aura descended from the crack. That was the intervention of the Heavenly Secrets Pavilion—an existence even more mysterious than the Heavenly Eye had entered this war."

"'Holder of the Tianji Record, your time to fall has not yet come.' That voice was cold and ancient, like an ancient divine oracle. Chen Ji felt the death symptoms on his body suddenly stop, the force eroding his body forcibly suppressed by an even more powerful force. The Heavenly Eye's consciousness let out an angry howl, then slowly retreated."

"Chen Ji collapsed on the ground, gasping for breath. His body was still weak, but the threat of death was temporarily lifted. Yet he knew this was merely a temporary respite—the Heavenly Eye would not let this rest, and the Heavenly Secrets Pavilion's intervention was not without cost. On the Tianji Record Fragment, a new line of blurry text appeared: 'Chapter Seven Hundred, Death Prophecy—to be continued.'"
